paper_metadata.title: Effect of element Zr in Ti-Zr–Ni–Nb system brazing filler alloys on the microstructure and strength of TiAl/TiAl joints

evidence.quote: A series of Zr-Ti-Ni-Nb system filler alloys with different content of Zr were developed and fabricated for TiAl joining.
